question: Ahead of the 2024 European elections, the Commission, with the assistance of the President of the European Parliament, allocated EUR 132.82 million to several media outlets.1 This large allocation was made in a completely non-transparent manner, with the purpose of these funds and the names of their recipients remaining secret.

Furthermore, the money was distributed through Havas NV, which is controlled by members of the Bolloré family, who have been supportive of hard-right ideologies.2 This raises serious concerns about the lack of transparency regarding whom the EU funds and about potential clandestine election interference, given the timing of the allocation. 1.
Which media outlets were the recipients of this allocation?
For what purpose were the funds allocated to those media outlets?
Will the current Commission allocate funds in a more transparent manner with clear recipients and clear purposes, instead of continuing to operate behind the backs of Parliament and EU citizens?
